name: Benjamin Addington
original_name: ベンジャミン・アディントン
source:
[i]"O-Of course! C-Christmas means better food than usual a-and... and it means we get presents!"[/i]

A 4th year student and one of Michael's roommates. A chatty, chubby boy who isn't good at social cues. He's a bit slow and clueless, so he often annoys his roommates. He's a prime target for Jack's bullying, but for some reason, they also get along pretty well.

[Translated from the [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/shingaku/]official website[/url]].
